text:
Power Stations | Technical
 Bulletin
Introduction
This document outlines the forming machine 
for metal expansion joints because of increasing the consumption rate of textile 
expansion joint at the inlet of hot gases to boiler (Heat recovery steam 
generator), so; metal expansion joints become necessary for long life and best 
utility.
Metal Expansion Joint is not saving in our store.
So; forming machine manufacture planning, designing and carryout by team work; eng. 
Abd El Kader Fathalla; eng. Abdou Abdou El Hendawy, eng. Ashraf Fahmy; tech. 
Mohamed Farag, tech. Gomah Abd El Wahab; tech Fakhry Aly Hamza; tech. Anees El 
Knawy.
The first draft initiated by team work; eng. Abd El Kader Fathalla, eng. Abdou 
Abdou El Hendawy; eng. Ashraf Fahmy; reviewed by director eng. Abd El Kader 
Fathalla; approved by eng. M. El Sarag Head Sector of Damietta CCPS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& 
financial quality control ,and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control 
head sector .
Information
Comparison between metal Expansion 
 Joint and textile expansion Joint
 | Textile | Metal
Working life | Consumable | Long life
Cost | Expansive | Low
Time required for | It is required to change out of program | Inspection and repair during Major Inspection
Material | Synthetic material | Heat resistant steel or stainless steel
Machine Technical Data
Form sheet metal with dimensions (3000x1300x1.5mm) to expansion joint As 
 attached drawing Fig. 1;
Forming machine descriptions as attached Drawing Fig . 2
4 Roller.
2 Axial bearing / Roller.
3 Press Forming.
9 Stud (2 nuts / stud).
4 Center bearing (one / roller)
4 Angle plate to sustain machine frame.
2 (Angle plate + Roller) as a guide for adjust sheet metal drawing at two side 
 of machine.
2 I beam for chassis of machine.
Tools Required
2 hydraulic jack.
2 Hammer, 4 wrenches.
1 Measuring tape.
Safety and healthy equipment as helmet, shoes, glove, ... 
etc
Grease
Report
It is possible to form sheet metal thickness 1 , 1.5 , 2 mm.
Change the dimensions of the rollers is possible to form different expansion 
 joint dimensions.
Advantages
Metal expansion joint is manufactured and used successfully.
Economic utility.
Local, manufacture to needless importation.
Reduce the units shut down periods for maintenance and improve the units 
performance.
Save hard currency.
